# Deprecated: prisma-postgres

Load `prisma-postgres-setup` with the host's skill loader or read its installed `SKILL.md`. If unavailable, install it from [prisma/skills](https://github.com/prisma/skills/tree/main/prisma-postgres-setup) before continuing.

This compatibility entry contains no setup recipes. Keep it until consumers have migrated to the replacement.
